selection_rule: Rank candidates by the number and importance of open validation gates that one rights-cleared blind release could address.

ranked_candidates.reason: More than 50 reported 350/700 bar tests include station delivery and tank channels.
Both vessel types and multiple aspect ratios directly test the current thermal-model failure.
The experiment records transient high-flow boundaries and spatial temperature response in a large Type-IV tank.
A 28 kg-class Type-IV experiment can test capacity transfer, with an explicit boundary outside H70 scope.
The real Mid Flow Twin campaign can provide a station-to-vehicle holdout if synchronized logger channels are released.

required: custodian-held case identifiers and numerical outcomes
model commit and scoring protocol frozen before release
synchronized pressure, temperature and mass or flow
initial conditions, geometry, units and quality metadata
written journal and repository reuse terms
minimum_blind_release.fallback: If no blind subset exists, classify received files as post-publication diagnostics and retain the current readiness failures.

claim_boundary: This ranking is a planning artifact. It is not validation evidence, records no sent contact, changes no readiness gate and does not make a journal-acceptance claim.
